a.text: Fairytales tell of a castle that only children can see, somewhere in Victoria.
Kind fairies live in the castle, treating children to banquets and making their wishes come true with sweet dreams.
But no one knows what the Castle of Dreams really looks like.
The sweet dreams begin to fade from memory the moment the children leave the dream.
Sweet dreams are continuously created and forgotten.
Is this not rather unfair to the gentle, overworked fairies?

steps.text: Welcome to the Castle of Dreams. I am its current Master, Morpheus.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Master of the... Castle of Dreams...? You—what have you done?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Exactly what you dreamt of, no? I had you all dream a dream. Simple.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: *sigh* But your dreams are no entertainment. Just filled to the brim with boredom.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: (Mutters) Not to mention those... two horrid pests.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You know them? Iris... and Bena?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I wouldn't say we're intimate.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So they're real? They don't just exist in the dream?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I wish they only existed in dreams.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now could you stop bringing them up?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You're talking to me! I'm the Master of this place right now!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Let me leave.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Not happening.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Why would I just let you go, now? So few children have come to the Castle of Dreams lately.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: The Corettons can't talk. There's a single Wolff and it can't stop stammering.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Dismayed chirping)

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: S-Sorry.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You trapped me in this castle because you, personally, were bored?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: As if I'd do it to just anyone! No.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Your memories were interesting—your experiences. And those alien places! I studied them over and over.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You pried into my memory...?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Didn't the blue one tell you? Understanding a child's past is vitally important to creating a dream for them.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now. You're quite special...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Even after all the unforgettable things you've been through, your mind has stayed clear as a whistle.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Now, to make up for this little regret, I'll spin you another sweet dream. We happen to be face-to-face this time, so you can tell me—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Wallowing in dreams and the pain of the past is a sign of weakness.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Heh. Stubborn, aren't you!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well, if you're to be believed, and those who cannot face the truth are cowards...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Then there certainly are a lot of cowards around.
The curtains are pulled open, and chairs slowly rise from under the stage.
In those chairs sit the most familiar faces Sakiko could know.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Uika... Mutsumi?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yūtenji-san... even Yahata-san?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Why are they all sleeping?
The surroundings have become as a stage.
The sleeping girls are like dolls on a set in peaceful slumber.
Not a whisper, not a sound.
Sakiko tries to wake each one of them up, but to no avail.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Save it. It's useless.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I'm more than confident in my abilities. They're deep in their sweet dreams, and you won't be able to rouse them.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Say, is there anything wrong with the dreams I've spun for you?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Your Rhodes Island friends trust you. Isn't that nice? No unwanted farewells, and no need to hide behind a mask.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Look at these girls. Are you calling them cowards too?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Since I can wake up from your dream, they can too...
Suddenly, Sakiko feels powerful forces pulling at her, and finds her limbs caught tightly in threads.
She fights the panic of not being in control of her own body, trying to stay calm.
But the tightly-wound threads magnify her every tremble.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You are SO STUBBORN. Can't you just admit when a dream is beautiful?!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You...
Sakiko struggles to rein in her breathing.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You... you do seem confident in your powers, don't you?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Perhaps no one before me has escaped one of your dreams.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Of course! I'm the top dreamspinner of all the Castle's fairies.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Your awakening was an accident. Give it another shot, and I'm sure it won't happen again!
Sakiko can clearly see Morpheus clenching her teeth through those last few words, but an expression of bright innocence replaces it in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Yes... Sakiko Togawa, was it?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: If you're so confident, let's make a bet!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...A bet?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Yes! An absolutely fair and even one!
The more childlike the smile on her conversant's face, the more dangerous she seems.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hah-hah! It's very simple!
Even as the girl rounds the stage, Sakiko can feel Morpheus's glare fixed on her. Not just hers; there are countless more eyes on Sakiko, peering from the darkness.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I'll invite you into each of their dreamlands, and give you the opportunity to wake them up.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You can meet them, get to know them, and see the kinds of lives they're leading in there. I'll let you leave if you can make them wake up like you did.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And if you fail, they'll stay dreaming forever!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I'll wake them up.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I won't leave a single member of Ave{@nbs}Mujica behind.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I selected each of them because they were the best of the best. I will not allow you to manipulate any of them.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hah-hah! We'll see about that. If you fail, I'll have a nice tailor-spun dreamland for you to go back into too.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And this time, you won't wake up again. I'll make you forget all your old hurt and make you willingly live inside it.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well? Getting cold feet? Do you want to take back all that bluster?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I could decline on the spot, but you would hardly let me go, would you?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hah-hah! You're smart!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I look forward to seeing the look of despair and helplessness on your face when you find yourself in their dreams, Sakiko Togawa.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I'll prove it to you—you won't get away.
Morpheus waves a finger, and Sakiko's vision immediately blurs.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Nngh—!
Colorful, twisted lights and shadows rush into Sakiko's mind.
A cheering crowd in front of the stage.
A shadow in a rainy night.
A lone girl sitting on a chair.
Countless indistinct silhouettes.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Enjoy sweet dreams—
An unending stream of cars, towering buildings reaching into the clouds, and inescapable neon signs.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Am I out of dreamland now?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Shouting Vendor
steps.text: Fresh finballs! Have a look, have a bowl!

steps.name: Busy Passerby
steps.text: Hurry! There's a whole line waiting! We'll be late for the event!

steps.name: Experienced Deliveryman
steps.text: Hello! Package—nobody home? I'll leave it at the door then?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Modern buildings, animal ears... what is this place?
The words 'Traditional Lungmen Hand-made' are printed on the packaging of snacks by the name of 'finballs'.
Pedestrians hitch rides on vehicles with large 'Lungmen Transport' signs that rush past before her eyes.
The deliveryman's shirt bears the same word, too. 'Lungmen'.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Lungmen... whose dreamland could this be?
Sakiko hears a familiar voice coming from above—
Good even-nyamu-nyamu~!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Hello to all my fans! Fresh new talent Nyamu here!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: My newest role as the lead in The Drummer Girl is in theaters right now! Support your local Nyamu today~

spans.text: My newest role as the lead in
is in theaters right now! Support your local Nyamu today~

steps.name: Feline Crowd
steps.text: It's 3 in the morning! Sleepless nights! What if you get hungry then?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: 'NyamuX' finballs are here for you!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: The favorite finballs of Nyamu and cloudbeasts alike! Order yours now!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Get your makeup done in just ten minutes!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: The 'Dream Painter' express kit lets you get the perfect makeup in just a few simple steps!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Come with Nyamu! Let's be the mes we wanna be~!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Nyamu loves you too~!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Her ads are everywhere in this dream...

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: I'm going CRAZYYYYYYY!!!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Guh...!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Nyamu's so... SO cute!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Every expression, every move, every word, omigosh she just teases my heartstrings!

steps.name: Thrilled Fan
steps.text: C-Can I really become as pretty as Nyamu?

steps.name: Thrilled Fan
steps.text: —I wanna buy the same thing!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: This place is packed. Is everyone here just to see her?

steps.name: Elderly Fan
steps.text: Of course... Nyamu, she's like a daughter to me, oh, she's so lovely...

steps.name: Elderly Fan
steps.text: Hahahahah...

steps.name: Elderly Fan
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are you alright...?!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Nyamu! Nyamu! I see her!!

steps.name: Thrilled Fan
steps.text: Where? Where? Move it, lemme through!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: E-Excuse me! Please don't push...!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yūtenji—!!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hah-hahahahah...! Look at the state of her. And it's only just begun! How very, very fun!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Joyful chirping)

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: W-Why?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: There—there's no need... she—she c-can't win...

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: And there's no need for you to chime in when you can't even talk properly.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I can figure this out... While she's in that dream, I can figure out what went wrong.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I AM the most talented dreamspinner in this castle.
Morpheus gazes upon the slumbering girl, and says no more.
